sourceQuote: Program alumni are found to have brilliant skills and sophisticated communication skills in Chinese, and are thus warmly welcomed by large multinational corporations, trade companies and financial departments inChina, as well as the home countries of the students.
targetQuote: 往届毕业生具备出色的技能和较高水平的汉语沟通能力，因此深受大型跨国公司、商贸公司以及中国金融机构和部门的欢迎，也同样受到学生所在国相关机构的青睐。
